Your experience. The right emphasis.

Compare a job description with your master resume, then create an evidence-based draft.

This tool uses local keyword matching to select and reorder your existing evidence. It does not use an AI model or verify your claims. It never invents skills, achievements, or experience. Resume details stay in this browser; no applications are submitted. Job cards offer one-click Oxford-style PDF downloads using your saved master resume. No ATS percentage is guaranteed.

1. Your source & target

Edit your master resume

Preloaded from the resume you supplied. Each experience/project has a heading and evidence bullets. Edit the JSON to correct facts or add real evidence. Saving does not change past drafts.

LaTeX comments and the message embedded inside your ETL section have been omitted. Review all source claims before use.

2. Review your tailored draft

Paste a job description to see matched skills, requirements needing evidence, and the changes made.

Single-column output with standard section headings. Download PDF produces a text-based, single-column Oxford-style document. Print is also available; LaTeX downloads are compiled separately in Overleaf. Keyword overlap is not an ATS score or a selection prediction.
